get.summary: Read the openapi document of the admin api (json)
get.description: Answers the openapi 3.0.3 document of the admin api: the operations of the generic api of every kind of entity, the other operations of the admin api, and their schemas. The document is computed once and cached. This documentation endpoint is public on the backoffice host. When the `otoroshi.doc-resources.accessKey` setting is set (outside of the dev mode), it requires the basic credentials `doc:<accessKey>`, or the `doc_secret` query parameter. On the host of the admin api, it is served through the route of the admin api and requires its credentials.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version written in the `info` of the document, instead of the version of otoroshi

parameters.name: extension_group
parameters.description: Only describes the paths of the generic api of a group of entities (`/apis/<group>`), with the tags and the schemas they use

parameters.name: core
parameters.description: `true` only describes otoroshi and the admin extensions shipped with it, leaving out the entities of the third party admin extensions

parameters.name: doc_secret
parameters.description: The access key of the documentation (`otoroshi.doc-resources.accessKey`), or the base64 encoding of `doc:<accessKey>`, when it is set

200.description: The openapi 3.0.3 document of the admin api, in json

400.description: On the host of the admin api, the credentials of the admin api are missing

401.description: The access key of the documentation is set and neither the basic credentials nor `doc_secret` give it, or, on the host of the admin api, the credentials of the admin api are wrong

404.description: No path of the document belongs to the group `extension_group`

429.description: On the host of the admin api, the quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

get.description: Answers the kinds of entities the generic api serves on `/apis/<group>/<version>/<plural_name>`, the ones of the admin extensions included, with the json schema of each version. The schemas the hand written schemas do not cover are computed by reflection on the class of the entity, which takes time on the first call.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: `false` answers the schemas without computing the missing ones: only the hand written schemas of the core entities, `null` for the other ones

200.description: The version of otoroshi and every kind of entity the generic api serves, with the json schema of its version

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded
